title: AI agent governance takes focus as regulators flag control gaps
summary: Australia's financial regulator APRA has issued a warning to financial institutions about poor AI agent governance and assurance practices, following a targeted review of large regulated entities' AI adoption in late 2025. As banks and superannuation trustees expand AI deployment in internal operations and customer-facing services, regulators are flagging significant control gaps in how AI agents are governed.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of proper governance frameworks for AI agents deployed in regulated financial institutions.
why_valuable: Highlights critical regulatory compliance risks as AI agents become more autonomous in sensitive financial operations.
